title: b7z9.30.1: C: implement AdaptiveSFSelect procedure in rf_health.c
description: Port the AdaptiveSFSelect multi-step procedure from Python ccp.py:226-243 / Rust rf_health.rs:411-438 to C rf_health.c. Currently C has only the threshold table (rf_health.c:100-115 lichen_rf_health_adaptive_sf) but no step-by-step select procedure (absent SF->10, density/utilization/SNR/loss/loadfactor steps). Add new function lichen_rf_health_adaptive_sf_select().
close_reason: Duplicate of worker2's closed b7z9.30.1/b7z9.30.2 (commits cd395410c6, 84add2fa04, 8ea04cd3bd): the full AdaptiveSFSelect procedure (steps 1-5 incl. absent-SF default 10, density/utilization +2, SNR upgrade, loss/utilization +1 with util>200 (12,false) tx-block) now exists in C lichen_gradient_sf_select (gradient.c ~294-345) with boundary tests in routing_dispatch.
